title: complete
description: Result of `stride complete <id> [activity]`. `rest` marks the bare form, allowed only for rest days.

replaced_activity.description: The activity whose completion of this session was REPLACED by this call, or 0 if none was. `complete` on a session that is already `done` overwrites the link — it is the documented repair for a mis-linked completion, and `skip`'s own refusal message names it as such — but until #258 the payload was indistinguishable from a first-time completion, so a typo'd session id rewrote real history and reported plain success. Always present rather than optional: a consumer deciding whether history was rewritten must not have to tell an absent key from a zero.
